content: अभ्याश {%a.%} Near, proximate. .{@-शः@} .²1 Reaching to, pervading. .²2 Proximate neighbourhood, vicinity (also written as अभ्यास <ab>q. v.</ab>); वायसाभ्याशे समुपविष्टः <ls>Pt. 2</ls>; सहसाभ्यागतां भैमीमभ्याशपरिवर्तिनीम् <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Dk. 62</ls>. .²3 Result, consequence. .²4 Prospect, hope of gaining; hence <ab>oft.</ab> used in the sense of ‘quickly’.
